about: Step order RouteBuilder keeps between builds of this guide. New steps are slotted in; the rest stay where they are. Lines can be moved by hand, including the training, vendor and flight-path steps written as { "lines": [...] }. Delete the file, or build with --fresh, to plan the guide from scratch.
